title: Uptown Lounge
venue_description:
Uptown Lounge - Kansas City's Premier Jazz & Cocktail Bar

Uptown Lounge located at 3400 Main Street in midtown Kansas City is an upscale cocktail and piano bar that has become a premier destination for live music in Kansas City. The venue distinguishes itself through an elegant atmosphere craft cocktails and high-quality live music programming.

Live Music Five Nights a Week

The venue features live music performances Tuesday through Saturday nights. Tuesday hosts the Brody & Bills Blues Jam open to all musicians. Other nights feature piano bar performances jazz acts and various skilled musicians. The programming emphasizes quality live performances rather than recorded music or DJs.

Tuesday Blues Jam

Every Tuesday from 8pm-midnight Brody Buster and Coyote Bill host the Brody & Bills Blues Jam. This open jam welcomes musicians of all skill levels and experience backgrounds. The house band provides professional accompaniment. Attendees and participants consistently praise the Tuesday jam as an epic musical experience with great vibes.

Upscale Atmosphere

Unlike many dive bar venues Uptown Lounge offers a refined sophisticated setting. The interior features elegant design and lighting creating an intimate yet upscale environment. The full bar specializes in craft cocktails and quality beverages. Comfortable seating and professional service complement the musical performances.

Kansas City Music Heritage

Kansas City has a legendary jazz and blues heritage dating back generations. The city produced iconic musicians and remains a vital live music destination. Uptown Lounge carries forward this tradition through its commitment to live music and by creating a venue where locals and visitors can experience contemporary jazz and blues performances.

Midtown Kansas City Location

Located at 3400 Main Street in midtown Kansas City the venue is part of the vibrant resurgence of Main Street as an entertainment and cultural district. The neighborhood has experienced revitalization with new galleries restaurants and entertainment venues creating a lively urban cultural scene.

Community & Atmosphere

The venue functions as a gathering place for music lovers and performers in Kansas City. The combination of quality live music an upscale environment and craft cocktails has made Uptown Lounge a destination for special occasions and regular visits. The owner Alan and bartender Von are known for warm hospitality and genuine engagement with patrons.
